sourceChecks.note: Vostok Europe's exact sold-out product route independently identifies VK61-571H614 and both factory-supplied black strap configurations. It publishes titanium, 45.7 x 15.6 x 56.2 mm geometry, 22 mm lugs, K1 crystal, 300 m resistance, VK61 meca-quartz, chronograph, date, 15 tritium tubes with continuous luminosity for at least ten years, and strap replacement with the included screwdriver or a coin. It publishes no configured mass; the scored leather-worn configuration is fixed by the later exact listing. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Vostok Europe's 2024 catalogue explicitly includes the titanium VK61-571H614 in the SSN 571 family and specifies VK61A accuracy of +/-20 seconds per month, three-year battery life, date, and chronograph. Its SSN 571 pages corroborate the geometry, lug width, tritium, two supplied straps, and replacement tool. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Vostok Europe's current general user guide distinguishes quick-release, regular spring-bar, and screw-fixed systems. It says screw-fixed straps require a screwdriver and use custom-made parts unavailable as standard aftermarket straps. Combined with the exact reference's screwdriver-or-coin procedure, this supports a screw-fixed proprietary mapping. A narrow Perplexity follow-up also asserted two TORX screws, but that exact hardware detail was not tied to VK61-571H614 and is not retained. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact official-Czech-distribution page exposes EUR 793 including VAT, an Add to cart control, official-distribution warranty language, and stock within three working days while simultaneously saying the product is momentarily unavailable. The homogeneous snapshot is normalized to a new authorized-dealer short_wait offer in the Czech Republic, never in_stock. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Direct review shows 'The sale has ended' and no current exact-product price or purchase control. The provider's EUR 774.33 in-stock claim came from stale indexed content and is rejected. Helveti's +/-15 seconds-per-month row is also weaker than the manufacturer's current +/-20 catalogue contract. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Vostok Europe's official Japanese route exposes the exact reference, both supplied straps, a screwdriver, JPY 137,500, and a 100 g field. It does not identify which installed strap the 100 g covers, and the unsupported JPY offer does not replace the reviewed EUR market snapshot. The ambiguous mass is not promoted. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact authorized Japanese listing labels approximately 100 g as main-body weight while separately listing both straps. This helps explain why 100 g cannot satisfy the full configured-mass field but does not establish the black-silicone total. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact-reference retailer lists black silicone and 134 g, but supplies no scale image, protocol, or explicit statement that the value is the complete watch on that strap. It conflicts with the ambiguous 100 g regional-manufacturer field and nearby 135-136 g catalogue records. A narrow Perplexity follow-up found no configuration-explicit measurement, so no mass is selected or averaged. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact VK61-571H614 listing explicitly titles the configured product on its black leather strap, describes the petrol contrast stitching, lists the silicone strap separately as an included accessory, and publishes approximately 135 g in the same configuration-specific details. This resolves the earlier 100 g head-only versus unscoped 134-136 g conflict for the leather-worn row. The page shows contradictory sold-out and cart controls, so its EUR 599 commercial state is not selected; the reviewed Czech short-wait snapshot remains. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
